title: Big Globe - Create: Molten Vents Compatibility
description: Adds compatibility between Create: Molten Vents and Big Globe by enabling aquatic vents to generate naturally in Big Globe oceans.
body:
Create: Molten Vents + Big Globe Compatibility

This datapack enables aquatic vents from [Create: Molten Vents](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-molten-vents) to generate correctly in worlds using [Big Globe](https://modrinth.com/mod/big-globe) terrain generation.

Big Globe replaces Minecraft’s default world generation pipeline, which prevents Molten Vents from spawning naturally.
This datapack integrates the vents into Big Globe’s feature dispatcher system so they generate properly in ocean environments.

Features

Adds aquatic vents to Big Globe oceans
Uses Big Globe's scripted feature dispatcher system
Spawns vents only in ocean biomes
Requires minimum ocean depth of 25 blocks
Balanced spawn rates to keep vents rare discoveries

Supports all aquatic vent types:

Asurine
Veridium
Crimsite
Ochrum
Scorchia
Scoria

This datapack should work with both NeoForge and Fabric versions of Molten Vents as long as the feature IDs remain unchanged.
